pages.text: Most recipes run anywhere. $(item)Nether recipes$() need either the $(item)Nether Upgrade$() or their real environment:$(br2)Blaze over netherrack. Nether wart over soul sand or soil. Magma cubes over a magma block or lava. Crimson and warped fungus over their nylium. Other Nether mobs in the Nether dimension. The Shulker needs the End.
If an environment is missing, Jade and The One Probe tell you what the farm needs.
